summary: Website to display handwritten notes for CBSE Class 11 Chemistry named reactions, with a homepage/front page stating "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA" and notes accessible on separate pages.
imageRequirements:

- Chalkboard-style hero background with subtle chemistry doodles and no readable text (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)

- Handwritten notes page image with notebook paper texture and chemistry handwriting titled "Fittig Reaction" (note-fittig.dim_1200x1600.png)
- Handwritten notes page image with notebook paper texture and chemistry handwriting titled "Wurtz-Fittig Reaction" (note-wurtz-fittig.dim_1200x1600.png)

existing_features.title: Create a homepage/front page that prominently displays the exact text: "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA".
Add a named reactions index page for CBSE Class 11 Chemistry that lists available named reactions and allows opening each reaction on its own separate page.
For each named reaction page, display the handwritten notes as one or more static images with basic viewing UX (responsive layout; click-to-open larger view or similar).

Apply a coherent visual theme across the site (colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for a Class 11 chemistry notes website, and keep it consistent across the homepage, index, and reaction pages.
Add the generated handwritten-notes images and any decorative images as static frontend assets and render them directly from the frontend (do not fetch images from the backend).
